title: Food Delivery API
subtitle: Scalable order pipeline handling concurrent kitchens, riders, and live tracking with Django + Celery.
challenge: Designed for horizontal scaling: async task queues, Redis caching, and PostgreSQL read replicas to absorb peak-hour traffic.

title: AI Multi-Agent Store
subtitle: Autonomous storefront where Autogen agents negotiate inventory, pricing, and customer support in real time.
challenge: Orchestration of specialized LLM agents through a shared memory bus, with deterministic tool routing and guardrails.

title: Social Bookstore Backend
subtitle: Community-driven bookstore where readers share shelves, reviews, and trade copies through a clean domain model.
challenge: Hexagonal architecture with strict ports & adapters — domain logic isolated from frameworks, fully unit-testable.
